A fifth asks for a flag-injury callout on the Liability and safety card; that card IS the site's liability disclosure (authored by the safety pass), it names no procedure, and a 'Can injure you' label on a disclaimer would restate the card's own sentence. The sixth ('Built from inside an RV' as site-centred voice) would remove the page's positioning. Rules 1, 2, 5 and 6 came back clean, and the reviewer confirmed the page's figures hold (48/48 guides carry a checked date, six years matches since-2020).
